horizon_framing: h=1 is the first temporal attribution setting: features observed at year t are aligned to the target proxy at year t+1. This does not establish causality by itself; it only enforces temporal order.
zero_imputation_meaning: In x_scaled_imputed, zero means the train-period mean after standardization. Missing values are set to zero only after scaling, and x_mask must be used to distinguish imputed values from observed values that are close to the train mean.

required_baselines_before_stgnn.name: persistence
required_baselines_before_stgnn.definition: predict y(t+1) from y(t) for the same node

required_baselines_before_stgnn.name: autoregressive_tabular
required_baselines_before_stgnn.definition: predict y(t+1) using y(t), optional lagged features and masks, without graph propagation
required_baselines_before_stgnn.purpose: tests whether temporal/tabular signal beats persistence before adding graph structure

required_baselines_before_stgnn.name: spatial_neighbor_average
required_baselines_before_stgnn.definition: predict y_i(t+1) using the row-normalized adjacency times y(t), with optional blend against node persistence
required_baselines_before_stgnn.purpose: tests whether neighboring zones add signal before training a learned graph model

leakage_controls: Feature scaling is fitted only on train samples.
Validation, test and forecast_holdout years do not influence feature means or standard deviations.
Missing values are imputed only after scaling and masks are stored explicitly.
readiness_note: This package is ready for baseline and STGNN input experiments, but the train split has only 3 annual samples. Deep model results must be treated as exploratory.
